record.field: Your Open Source Village pass is active ({{ object.member_number }})

div.p: Your pass for Open Source Village is active from to . Your member number is .

1. Sign in to Belfry. This link signs you in once, without a password, and expires on . Later, sign in at with your e-mail address: you get a new sign-in link by mail each time (or present your pass).

a.style: background-color: #875A7B; padding: 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 13px;

t.p: 2. Add the pass to your wallet. Open this page and scan the code with your EUDI wallet (or another OpenID4VCI wallet); the pass certificate shows your tier and validity at the door and signs you in to the apps:

a.style: background-color: #1F2A44; padding: 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 13px;

p.a: Add the pass to your wallet

div.p: 3. Use the community apps. Open and choose "Sign in with Belfry". Your Nostr key is kept safe by Belfry; your public key is .
If the link has expired, just sign in with your e-mail address as described above.

See you at the village,
Belfry
